Q6181.reason: 2017 global burden estimates rank lower respiratory infections first among under-five deaths, with more than 800,000 deaths, ahead of preterm birth and other neonatal causes.

Q9001.reason: About 700–800 million people under $1.90 a day in 2019 is roughly 9–10% of a 7.7 billion world population, closest to 10%.

Q9006.reason: Terrorism deaths in 2017 were in the tens of thousands—about 26,000—from conflicts in Iraq, Syria, Afghanistan, Nigeria, and Somalia, and far below 100,000.
